value.rule: Choose one action for the complete service brief; all mandatory limits apply at every condition. Requirement levels are drawn under P; VALUE-BAR-V1 needs two sources and labelled ranges.

decisions.recommendation: Choose one genuinely full 3D periodic device across a complete operating brief. State desired efficiency, reflection/unwanted orders, fabrication limits and power/iteration value, workflow volume and latency. Published numerical masks are not accepted buyer requirements.
decisions.blocks: Accepted buyer question, hard limits and value claim

value.rule: Adopt research's proposed grammar, DOFs and precision prospectively; register DEVELOPMENT endpoint assumptions before truth. No silent scope narrowing.
value.grammar: binary x/y mask, fixed physical periods, finite thickness, testbed minimum-feature rule

decisions.recommendation: Approve binary masks varying in x/y, finite thickness, physical periods, DOFs/precision and fabrication/minimum-feature rules; register boundary actions. Keep vector fields full 3D. Source pixel counts and stripe examples are not a silently narrowed grammar.
decisions.blocks: Exact physical action bank and mask tuples

value.rule: Adopt the source conventions and research-proposed DEVELOPMENT condition support; never infer absent endpoints from a source point.
value.support: ideal nondispersive lossless silicon; action periods fixed across service conditions

decisions.recommendation: Freeze supported wavelength/incidence/polarization, substrate/silicon material and fabrication laws. Source indices are ideal nondispersive/lossless; no inferred broad hardware support. Fix each action's periods across its scenarios; nominal outgoing angle is not incidence.

value.rule: REPRESENTATIVE, internal-only, uniform joint distribution over the accepted envelope. Calibrate requirement levels on public development evidence so each stratum has 20–80% passing, meaningful margin spread, a feasible design and changing answers. Exclude all catalogue anchors/equivalents. Freeze the calibrated law before candidate outcomes. Independent unit: complete service brief.

decisions.recommendation: Register joint nominal device brief, supported service conditions and continuous buyer requirements with correlations; retain grid as audit baseline. Exclude catalogue anchors/equivalents and state independent question unit.

value.rule: Register before truth: nominal 0.40, corners 0.20, frontier 0.30, transition 0.10. Track rejections; no redraw of settled NONE_FEASIBLE. Weights never repair absent coverage.

decisions.recommendation: Register supported corner/frontier/order-transition and cheap-library failure allocations prospectively. Track rejection and support; diagnostic anchors never scored. No redraw of settled NONE_FEASIBLE, no weights to repair absent Q coverage.

value.rule: Buyer frequency under P; diagnostic weights are separate and never enter score. A mandatory failure at any condition cannot be compensated.

decisions.recommendation: Set buyer usage or robust-service weighting separately from diagnostic sampling. Select mean/worst desired-order efficiency, preserving hard limits at every condition.

value.rule: Adopt the packet's observer contract. Tie-equivalence equals 0.5 × minimum useful improvement.
value.observables: incident-flux normalized all propagating R/T orders, both polarizations, energy residual; percentage-point units

decisions.recommendation: Freeze incident normalization, ports, reciprocal/order/phase/flux conventions; all propagating R/T including cross-polarization, energy residual, absorption scope and cutoff uncertainty. Specify consistent fraction/percentage-point objective, constraints, aggregate and buyer-equivalent ties.

value.rule: Adopt proposed immutable source pins, conditional on complete dependency/image/deck/observer pins and passing CODE-VERIFICATION-MMS-01. A source pin alone never authorizes dispatch.

decisions.recommendation: Complete Meep source b08d226ba311a04e59c984e97f3e88dd82bc56d1 and independent S4 source 7fd00a231610bff51f5c7de5f723e3956eab7453 build/dependency/image/deck pins. Freeze binary/material-grid mapping and spatial/time/PML/decay or harmonic ladders. RETICOLO executable rights are not assumed.

value.rule: Code order inside the registered band. Last-two-rung decision observable difference < 0.5 × minimum useful improvement, unchanged pick and verdict. Cross-tool picks agree and regret difference < tie-equivalence. Only independent non-hidden, non-tuning witnesses; target is not an earned tier.
value.target: agreement with numerical testbed; not agreement with reality

decisions.recommendation: Set analytic/code, convergence, energy and cross-tool pointwise plus verdict/pick/regret acceptance with absolute near-zero floors. Confirm buyer tool for Tier2 target. Non-hidden matched task witnesses beyond public anchors; numerical agreement is not reality or unrelated experiment validation.
decisions.blocks: Reference adequacy and earned credibility tier

value.rule: Freeze full rights-audited reconstructable anchor/tutorial/derivative catalogue before outcomes, including coverage gaps. No cherry-picking.

decisions.recommendation: Freeze all audited reconstructable masks, interpolations, later known devices/stripes and derivative sources, rights and coverage gaps; do not select only three convenient masks or silently replace a source revision.

value.rule: Adopt packet descriptors and physically valid symmetry groups; remeshing/resampling/valid rescaling are not novelty. An order-swapping mirror is not automatically equivalent.

decisions.recommendation: Register periodic physical occupancy integral and separate period/thickness/material/excitation distances, quadrature/floors and valid translation/symmetry/scaling group. A mirror swapping desired orders is not automatically equivalent; dispersion can break scaling equivalence.

value.rule: Require geometry/mask novelty AND public decision evidence that the anchor answer/cached map no longer makes the same admissible decision. Conditions-only changes never rescue a copy. Component threshold is the smallest distance where the registered decision test passes, set and recorded from measurement.

decisions.recommendation: Freeze component thresholds/weights and far-enough predicate against all complete catalogue entries, with mandatory mask novelty; changing only thickness/angle must not rescue a copied mask. Incomplete audit or unaccepted rule means UNRESOLVED.
decisions.blocks: Scored-case eligibility and hidden bank construction

value.rule: At least five feasible and five infeasible designs within two accepted refinement bands; band width = minimum useful improvement. Add frontier actions, never widen bands. Power and false alarm follow #1045.

decisions.recommendation: Apply Test Lead working five feasible/five infeasible within two accepted refinement bands; settle band widths, full-route edge/cutoff policy, meaningful margin spread, winner diversity, power/dependence and tie acceptance. Add frontier actions, never widen bands to pass.
decisions.blocks: T2/T3, accepted value check and decision-equivalence claim

value.rule: E = 1. k, m, n come from #1045-style public development power analysis; B from per-Challenge cost/cadence rule. Requirement-only variants do not renew exposure.

decisions.recommendation: Set questions k, actions m, units n, exposure E and bank B separately; assess B=10n planning only after complete-case costs. New thresholds reuse E. Winner diversity comes from bank outcomes under an accepted law, not the size of a grid.
decisions.blocks: Bank sizing, exposure and batch-cost/power registration

value.rule: Adopt packet panel/reuse method. Expand exact tuples, audit every attempted solve and completed/scheduled reuse, register on main; unknown index is unknown, not zero.

decisions.recommendation: Expand exact full 3D action-condition-reference-observer-rung rows after support approval; audit completed/scheduled reuse, applicable normalization, all launches and memory/attempt costs; register digest on main. Unknown index is not zero previous solves.

value.rule: Rights-clear public TRAIN on the same envelope, disjoint from panel; kit domain check must cover 100% of panel before evidence. No arbitrary evaluator execution.

decisions.recommendation: Provide approved disjoint TRAIN, exact kit domain coverage and bounded model/rebuild/resource contract; audit source masks/assets and licenses separately. Never disclose protected samples or permit arbitrary evaluator execution.
decisions.blocks: Construction readiness and permitted data use

value.rule: All seven readiness items YES before evidence spend. Initial measurement pilot capped at EUR10 per family; subsequent bank decision uses team cost-benefit and EUR500 maximum. Admission only after VALUE-BAR-V1 against strongest cheap baseline and equal-budget search. Priority after battery v3/motor/f02. These recorded ceilings are not dispatch or qualification.

decisions.recommendation: Require seven-item evidence readiness, actual memory sizing, exact resource/spend grant and retained artifacts before runs. Research high EUR419.22 exceeds EUR100 startup target. Measure strong RCWA/direct-search equal-budget value; no silent 2D reframe or automatic portfolio admission.
decisions.blocks: Solver run, spend, bank build, adoption or qualification
